resources.string: "Daily standard hours must be greater than 0 and no more than 24."
"Pay must be zero or a positive number."
"The monthly hours target must be greater than 0 and no more than 744."
"The period start day must be between 1 and 31."
"The final overtime tier must cover all remaining hours."
"Check the tier hours and pay percentages."
"The number of entries or their IDs is invalid."
"The active shift overlaps an existing entry."
"Unable to connect your Google account right now. You can back up to a file and try again later."
"Google authorization was not granted (code %1$s). Reconnect or use a backup file."
"The operation failed. Your local data was preserved."
"No ShiftHours backups were found in this account."
"Connection canceled. No backup or restore was performed."
"Keep your work hours when moving to a new phone."
"Access granted. A successful backup is shown only after the upload finishes."
"No Drive backup has completed for this account yet."
"Backups are stored in Drive\'s hidden app data folder, not as ordinary files. To restore on a new phone, install the same app and connect the same Google account."
"Only on an unmetered network, such as Wi-Fi"
"Scheduling is available after connecting Drive. Android may delay backups to save battery or when offline. Use the button above to create the first backup immediately."
"Disconnected locally and canceled the schedule. Existing backups were not deleted."
"Save a backup file on your computer, in Drive, or elsewhere, even before setting up the app\'s Google connection."
"Backups include entries, an active shift, settings and saved reasons. Before restoring, a preview is shown and a local copy of your previous data is saved."
"Open the copy saved before the last restore"
"This device holds %1$s entries. Reconnect Google and configure the backup schedule on each phone."
"Recovery mode: local data could not be read. Restore from a file or Drive; creating new backups is disabled."
"No backups found in the selected account."
"Restoring will replace the %1$s entries and settings on this device. A local copy will be saved first."
"This backup is incompatible with this app version."
"This is not a supported ShiftHours backup."

"Enter time as hours:minutes or decimal hours."
"The end day must precede the start of the next period."
"Set your working terms and save to get started."
"Applies to all entries, including past entries."
"Hourly rate = monthly salary ÷ monthly hours target. Gross pay includes the full monthly salary plus overtime payments at the configured rates."
"Gross pay is calculated from recorded hours and the configured tiers."
"Enter decimal hours or hours:minutes, such as 2.5 or 2:30."
"This tier applies after regular hours and all tiers above it."
"Exactly one \'all remaining hours\' tier is required, in the final row. Adding a tier makes the previous tier limited; check its hours."
"The days are linked to avoid gaps or overlaps, for example 25–24. In a short month, the start date adjusts to the last day available."
"Also deduct breaks when working from home"
"A daily break is deducted once across eligible segments in time order. Home work is excluded when its option is off. Deductions never exceed the actual time worked."
"No break deduction. All recorded time counts as payable time."
"Only affects daily shortfalls. The same overtime tiers apply on all days; there are no separate weekend or holiday rules."
"Tax credit points and estimated net pay"
"Leave blank to hide the net estimate. Each point is worth ₪242 per month under the 2026 Israeli tax table."
"Enter the employee\'s share only, excluding employer contributions."
"Include the standard pension contribution tax credit"
"The pension tax credit estimate is 35% of eligible contributions, capped at ₪679 of contributions per month and 7% of pay. This is a monthly, noncumulative calculation."
"Income tax, tax credit points, Israeli national and health insurance, and employee contributions. Uses the 2026 tables for Israeli residents aged 18 to retirement."
"Excludes tax coordination, other income, taxable car benefits, employer contribution taxes and special credits. Compare with your payslip and refine as needed."
"Removing a saved reason does not change existing entries. You can always enter free text."
"The change was not saved. Try again."
"The files were preserved. Do not clear the app\'s data."
"Check the device clock: an entry ends in the future."
"The end time must be after the start time."
"You cannot record hours that have not occurred yet."
"The clock-in time cannot be in the future."
"Delete the entry for %1$s? This cannot be undone."
"Set your pay, monthly hours and working terms to enable pay calculations. You can record hours before completing setup."
"Swipe to start a shift at the current time."
"Swipe to end and save the shift at the current time."
"Your clock-in time is saved even when the app is closed."
"Segments on the same day are combined. An overnight shift belongs to its start date."
"Pay summaries will appear after saving the initial settings."
"No Drive backup has completed on this device yet."
"Settings and actions are available in the Backup tab below."
"Hours, pay and tracking for the period"
"The full monthly salary is shown. Missing hours are displayed separately and are not deducted automatically."
"Includes the active shift\'s hours within this period; amounts update live."
"Base-rate values exclude overtime premiums; do not add them to gross pay."
"Daily shortfalls count only selected working days with entries. Days without entries are not automatically marked as absences."
"Tax tables for %1$s are not configured. No net estimate is shown."
"Enter your tax credit points and employee pension percentage in settings to show an estimate. Enter 0 if there is no contribution."
"Monthly estimate using 2026 Israeli tables. Excludes cumulative tax, other income, taxable benefits and tax coordination. Contributions use the selected pay basis. Not a substitute for a payslip."
"Times are shown as hours:minutes; calculations retain source seconds. Your configured tiers apply on every day of the week."
"Tiers use the whole day, even when filtering to one work location."
"A shift is active. Correct its start or enter an end time on the Home screen."
"Segments on the same day share the overtime tiers. Do not enter overlapping segments."
"Save corrected start and keep shift open"
"Clock-out must be after clock-in. For an overnight shift, also choose the correct end date."
"Enter pay and monthly hours, then adjust overtime tiers, breaks and the reporting period. The dashboard appears after saving."
"Drive access was denied. Reconnect your Google account."
"The backup was not found in the selected account."
"Google is limiting requests. Try again later."
"Backup was not created: authorization is required again. Open Backup and reconnect."
"Language is saved on this device. Save changes before switching languages. Currency and tax rules keep their current settings."
"Net estimates for this country are not available yet. Hours and gross pay remain available."
"No verified tax table for this year. Net estimate is unavailable."
"Select a UK region and confirm that the supported employee profile applies."
"Israeli tax points and contribution rules do not apply to this country."
"I confirm that the UK profile below applies to me."
"Country and language are independent. Country alone does not establish eligibility for personal reliefs."
"Changing country changes the currency label, without converting salary amounts or overtime rules. Review your settings before saving."

"UK 2026/27: steady monthly pay annualised for Income Tax; monthly Category A National Insurance. Standard Personal Allowance with high-income taper. Only one employment; no other income, pension deductions, salary sacrifice, student loans, taxable benefits or special reliefs. This estimate is not cumulative PAYE."

"India FY 2025/26–2026/27: resident salaried employee, new regime only, steady annualised cash salary, no other income or special tax relief. Standard deduction, rebate, marginal relief and 4% cess included. Taxable annual income must not exceed INR 5,000,000."

"Russia 2026: tax-resident employee, ordinary steady salary only. No other income, personal tax deductions, northern allowances or special military rules. Tax is an annualised monthly average, not year-to-date payroll withholding. Employer social contributions are not deducted from employee pay."

"UAE 2026: non-GCC expatriate employee, employment income only. No personal income tax. Enter actual employee payroll deductions, including insurance where applicable. End-of-service benefits and employer contributions are excluded."

"Enter 0 if none. Include employee pension, insurance and local payroll deductions. Exclude the income tax/cess calculated here and employer contributions. This amount reduces take-home pay, not taxable income."
"I confirm that this country’s employee profile applies to me."
"Check the employee profile, deduction amount and supported income limits before estimating net pay."

"2026 only: full-year resident aged 18–64, one ordinary local W-2 employer, SINGLE or joint filing with ONE household earner. No dependents, other income, federal/refundable credits, special tips/overtime deductions, pretax benefits or interstate work. Verify eligibility. All 50 states selectable: 47 have scoped automatic state tariffs (including zero wage tax); CO/ID/VT require verified annual state liability entry. Tax/12 is a reserve, not W-4/YTD payroll withholding."

"Canada 2026: Ontario/Alberta only. Single full-year resident aged 18–64, living and working in the same province, one employer. Basic personal/employment credits only; no dependants, RRSP, pre-tax benefits or other income. Federal/provincial tax, CPP/CPP2 and EI included. Annual steady-pay average, not an actual pay run."

"Other post-tax employee deductions only; enter 0 if none. Do not re-enter taxes, Social Security, Medicare, CPP/CPP2, EI or Ontario Health Premium already calculated. Pre-tax deductions are not supported."
"Net estimates for this region are not supported yet."
"Enter the final taxable base after all allowances, from a verified assessment or professional calculation. This is not gross salary; the app does not derive it automatically."
"IETC requires full-year eligibility: no Working for Families entitlement, main benefit, NZ Super, Veterans Pension or equivalent overseas payment. Partial-year eligibility is not supported."
"Enter actual employee cash deductions not calculated here, or 0. Exclude employer contributions and taxes/insurance already shown. This reduces take-home pay, not the taxable base."

"Germany 2026: single resident, no children or church tax. Annual assessment using a verified final taxable base, not derived from gross pay. Enter actual employee social contributions separately. This is not Lohnsteuer payroll withholding."

"France: 2025 income assessed in 2026 only. Single resident, one tax share, salary only, annual gross up to EUR 200,000. Enter final taxable income after expense allowances; actual payroll social deductions separately. Includes décote; no 2026 income table or live PAS withholding."

"Portugal 2026: mainland, single resident, ordinary category A. Twelve equal payments including holiday/Christmas pro-rata; annual gross at least EUR 20,000. Includes 11% employee Social Security, standard deduction, IRS bands and solidarity. No dependants, special regimes or invoice credits; not a 14-payment withholding calculation."

"Australia FY 2025/26–2026/27: single resident aged 18–64, cash salary at least AUD 50,000 a year, excluding employer Super. No other income, pre-tax benefits or exemptions. Includes Income Tax, LITO, 2% Medicare and surcharge. Declare approved hospital cover for the whole year or none; families and partial cover excluded."

"New Zealand FY 2025/26–2026/27: full-year resident, salary only, one job, no other income or benefits. Income Tax and ACC included; IETC only after explicit eligibility confirmation. Enter actual KiwiSaver/loan/other employee deductions separately. Annual steady-income estimate."

"Spain 2026: Madrid only. Single full-year resident aged 18–64, salary only, no children, disability or tax credits. Annual cash gross at least EUR 40,000 and verified general taxable base at least EUR 30,000. National and Madrid tax include their basic personal minima. Actual social/payroll deductions are entered separately. Twelve equal total payments; not payroll withholding."

"China 2026: mainland full-year tax resident, salary only from one job, no other/foreign income or tax reductions. Enter a verified final annual taxable base after RMB 60,000 and all lawful deductions. Actual local social insurance/housing fund deductions are entered separately; no local rates or eligibility are inferred. No separately taxed annual bonus, treaty/special expat regime or monthly/YTD withholding."

"Saudi Arabia 2026: non-GCC expatriate, ordinary employment income in Saudi Arabia only. No personal income tax. Enter actual employee cash deductions, including insurance where applicable, or 0. Employer occupational-risk contributions are excluded. Saudi/GCC pension rules, business income, foreign tax liabilities and end-of-service benefits are outside this profile."

"Enter the verified final annual general taxable base BEFORE the personal/family minimum, after lawful salary deductions. Gross must be at least EUR 40,000; base at least EUR 30,000. The app applies the standard minima itself. No automatic social-insurance or gross-to-base calculation."

"Enter the verified final annual taxable salary base AFTER RMB 60,000 and all lawful deductions. Do not subtract RMB 60,000 again. Actual social/housing cash deductions must also be entered in the monthly employee-deductions field; their tax effect must already be in this base."

"Ireland 2026: single full-year resident aged 18–64, one qualifying PAYE job, salary only. Basic personal/employee credits and ordinary USC included. No proprietary director, medical-card concession, other income, pre-tax pension/benefits or extra credits. Enter actual employee PRSI and post-tax pension/other deductions separately; MyFutureFund eligibility is not inferred. Annual steady-income estimate, not cumulative payroll."

"Hong Kong 2025/26–2026/27: single full-year salary-only employee aged 18–64, one employer, regular monthly-paid MPF member. Includes hourly work paid monthly, basic allowance, employee MPF and lower progressive/standard tax. Contribution holidays must have expired before year start. No casual/daily-paid/exempt employees, dependants, other income or extra reliefs. 2025/26 final tax rebate only; not provisional-tax billing."

"Enter actual employee PRSI plus post-tax pension/other cash deductions, or 0. Include MyFutureFund if deducted; no automatic enrolment assumption. Exclude employer costs, Income Tax and USC already calculated. Income-tax-relieved pension contributions are outside this profile. Update actual deductions when pay changes."

"Only extra post-tax employee cash deductions, or 0. Do not re-enter the employee MPF or Salaries Tax calculated here. Employer contributions and extra tax-relieved deductions are outside this profile."

"Norway 2026: single full-year resident aged 18–64, one salary-only job, ordinary 22% region and National Insurance membership. Includes standard/personal deductions, step tax and verified youth work allowance where selected. No pension/union/interest/other deductions, other income, foreign-worker PAYE or special regional rules. Annual steady-income liability before tax-card prepayments and small-balance collection rules."

"South Africa 2025/26–2026/27: full-year resident aged 18–64, one ordinary private-sector salary job. Includes primary rebate and selected UIF treatment. No other income, commission, taxable benefits, pension tax deduction, medical/other credits or special exemptions. Confirm ordinary UIF coverage, or exemption solely for working under 24 hours per month for this employer. Annual steady-income estimate, not actual PAYE withholding."
"Excludes Svalbard, Finnmark and these Troms municipalities: Karlsøy, Kvænangen, Kåfjord, Lyngen, Nordreisa, Skjervøy, Storfjord."
"The 2026 pilot selected some people born in 1991–2006 at random. Being young or resident is not enough. Check your official status; do not guess. A blank status blocks the estimate."
"Years are labelled by their start: 2026/27 means March 2026–February 2027, called the 2027 tax year by SARS. Other UIF exemptions are outside this profile."

"Enter only extra post-tax employee cash deductions, or 0. Do not repeat calculated taxes or employee National Insurance/UIF, and exclude employer contributions. Tax-relieved pension or other deductible expenses require another profile."

"Singapore income year 2026: full-year tax resident aged 18–54 at year end, one ordinary-wage job, no bonus/additional wages, other income, disability, benefits or extra reliefs. Full-rate CPF citizen/PR from third year throughout the year, or foreign non-citizen/non-PR without CPF. Includes employee CPF and basic Earned Income Relief. Annual tax reserve estimate; not monthly tax withholding."

"Denmark 2026: Copenhagen only, single full-year resident aged 18–59, salary only, no church/capital/foreign income or special regime. Requires verified annual personal and municipal taxable bases before personal allowance, plus actual AM, ATP, employee pension and other cash deductions. Includes national/municipal tax and basic personal allowance; no automatic gross-to-base calculation or tax-card withholding."

"Enter both verified final bases BEFORE the personal allowance. Personal income is after AM/ATP/pension adjustments; municipal taxable income also reflects all lawful employment/job/other base deductions. Do not enter gross pay. The app does not derive either base or subtract these deductions again. If personal income exceeds DKK 54,100 but the municipal base is below DKK 54,100, this allowance-allocation case is not supported yet."
"Actual AM, ATP, pension and other cash deductions per month"

"Include actual AM labour-market tax, employee ATP/pension and other non-income-tax cash deductions, or 0. Their tax effects must already be reflected in the verified bases. Exclude employer costs and national/municipal income tax computed here. Update all three inputs when pay changes."
"Foreign tax resident — not citizen/PR, no CPF"
"2026 means income earned January–December 2026, assessed in YA 2027. Earlier one-off YA 2024/2025 rebates are not carried forward. PR first/second year and other CPF/age profiles are not supported."

"Only extra post-tax employee cash deductions, or 0, including actual community-fund deductions where applicable. Do not repeat calculated employee CPF or income tax, and exclude employer contributions. Extra tax-relieved deductions are outside this profile."

"Malaysia 2026: single full-year tax resident aged 18–59, one job with regular cash salary only; no other income, taxable benefits, special regime, zakat or other tax rebates. Requires a verified final annual chargeable income after all lawful reliefs including the self relief, and actual employee cash deductions. Includes the non-refundable RM400 personal rebate where eligible. Annual tax reserve estimate, not PCB withholding."

"Philippines 2026: single full-year resident citizen aged 18–59, one private job, 12 equal regular cash salary payments, no other taxable income, special regime or tax credits. Requires verified annual taxable regular compensation and actual employee deductions. Statutory minimum-wage-earner exemptions are outside this profile. Non-taxable 13th-month/other benefits up to the combined PHP90,000 limit are outside the displayed cash net; taxable excess or other bonus cases are unsupported. Annual estimate, not payroll withholding."

"Enter verified final annual chargeable income AFTER all lawful reliefs, including the RM9,000 self relief. Do not enter gross salary. The app applies the eligible RM400 rebate separately; it does not derive reliefs or subtract cash contributions again. Update the base when pay changes."

"Enter verified annual taxable REGULAR cash compensation after lawful employee contributions/dues, not gross pay. Do not deduct income tax or personal loan payments from this base. The app does not derive exemptions or subtract contributions again. Update the base when pay changes."

"Enter actual monthly employee EPF/SOCSO/EIS or SSS/PhilHealth/Pag-IBIG, lawful dues and other cash deductions, or 0. Their tax effects must already be reflected in the verified base. Exclude employer contributions and income tax calculated here. Update both amounts when pay changes."

"Poland 2026: single full-year resident aged 26–59, one ordinary employment contract, 12 equal cash salaries; annual gross up to PLN1,000,000. No other income, taxable benefits, joint filing, PIT-0, extra deductions or credits. Standard employment costs only (up to PLN3,600/year), not actual-ticket or 50% creative costs. Requires verified annual taxable base and actual cash deductions. Includes the basic PLN3,600 tax reduction. Annual estimate, not payroll withholding. PPK participants are outside this profile."

"Czechia 2026: single full-year resident aged 18–64, one ordinary employment with 12 equal regular cash salaries; no other income, taxable benefits, base deductions or extra credits. DPP/DPČ and special withholding cases are excluded. Includes the basic annual CZK30,840 non-refundable credit. Social, health and any minimum-health top-up must be entered as actual employee deductions. Annual assessment estimate, not monthly tax advances."

"Enter verified final annual taxable income after lawful employee social contributions and standard employment costs, BEFORE the PLN3,600 tax reduction. Do not subtract PLN30,000 separately. Health contributions, PPK and personal loan payments do not reduce this base in this profile. No second subtraction of cash deductions; update all amounts when pay changes."

"Enter actual monthly employee social/health insurance, post-tax pension and other cash deductions, or 0 if none. Include any applicable Czech minimum-health top-up. Exclude employer costs and income tax calculated here. Czech cash deductions do not reduce the tax base; Polish lawful tax deductions must already be in the verified base. Update when pay changes."

"Thailand 2026: single full-year resident aged 18–59, one ordinary salary job, no dependents, other income, special regime or tax credits. Requires verified annual employment income and final net taxable income after lawful expenses, allowances and exemptions. Salary only; the alternative minimum tax on other income is excluded. Current 30% band ends at THB5,000,000, not the old THB4,000,000."

"Indonesia 2026: single full-year resident aged 18–59, permanent employee, valid NPWP/integrated NIK, TK/0 with no dependents or other income. Annual Article 17 calculation after verified deductions and PTKP. Excludes DTP/government-borne tax, employer-paid/gross-up tax, special regimes and tax credits. Include THR/bonuses and taxable benefits in annual figures. Not monthly TER withholding."

"Vietnam 2026: single full-year resident aged 18–59, one salary job, no dependents, other income, special regime or tax credits. Requires verified annual employment income and final taxable base after lawful insurance, personal relief and exemptions, including any eligible overtime exemption. Five annual bands apply to resident salary from tax year 2026; do not reuse the old seven-band table."

"Taiwan 2026 income, filed in 2027: single full-year resident aged 18–59, salary only, no dependents, other/foreign income, AMT additions, special regime or tax credits. Requires verified annual employment income and final taxable base after all lawful exemptions/deductions and applicable basic-living-expense adjustment. Annual employment income limited to TWD7,500,000 as a conservative profile limit, not a legal gross AMT threshold."

"Sri Lanka 2026/27: 1 April 2026–31 March 2027. Single full-year resident aged 18–59, one ordinary domestic salary job, no other/foreign income, special regime, arrears/terminal-benefit treatment or tax credits. Requires verified annual income and final taxable base after LKR1,800,000 personal relief and other lawful deductions. Ordinary annual tax reserve, not APIT/YTD withholding."

"Enter the full selected tax year’s total employment income before reliefs, including bonuses, THR/extra salary and correctly valued taxable employer benefits. Do not enter only monthly pay ×12 when extra income applies. Verify this total and the final taxable base independently. Net shown is this period’s cash pay less annual tax/12 and actual employee cash deductions; it does not add annual bonuses or noncash benefits to cash payout."

"Enter the verified final annual taxable base after all lawful expenses, insurance deductions, personal allowances and exemptions for the selected year. The app does not decide eligibility or derive reliefs. They must not be subtracted again. Indonesia: PKP is floored to full IDR1,000. Update both annual amounts when income or circumstances change."

"Actual employee social/health/pension and other cash deductions for this period, or 0. Their lawful tax effects must already be in the verified annual base. Exclude employer costs and income tax reserved here. Do not enter tax withholding again. This is an annual tax reserve estimate, not a payslip or full annual net total."

"Peru 2026: single full-year domiciled resident aged 18–59, one fifth-category salary job only, no dependents, other/foreign income, special regime or tax credits. UIT=PEN5,500. Final verified taxable base already includes the 7-UIT deduction and any independently verified eligible additional expenses. Employee pension contributions are not automatically tax-deductible."

"Colombia 2026: single full-year resident aged 18–59, ordinary salary only, no dependents, other/foreign income, special regime or tax credits. UVT=COP52,374. Requires final verified annual taxable base after lawful social exclusions, exemptions and deduction limits. Uses annual Article241, not monthly Article383 withholding. Other taxes such as wealth tax are outside this salary estimate."

"Estonia 2026: single full-year resident aged 18–59, ordinary salary only, no dependents, other income, special regime or tax credits. 22% of verified final taxable base after lawful deductions and the EUR8,400 basic exemption. No old income-dependent exemption phase-out or pension-age allowance. Employee insurance/pension cash is entered separately."

"Latvia 2026: single full-year resident aged 18–59, ordinary salary only, no dependents, other income or tax credits. Annual total employment income limited to EUR105,300; higher-rate, solidarity and additional 3% cases are unsupported. 25.5% of verified final base after lawful contributions/deductions and EUR6,600 basic exemption. Not a complete high-income payroll calculation."

"Lithuania 2026: single full-year resident aged 18–59, ordinary fully taxable salary only, no dependents, other income, sickness benefits, disability/special NPD, extra deductions or credits. Annual rates 20%/25%/32%. Verified base after ordinary NPD only; employee social insurance is not deducted automatically. Above annual income EUR83,237.40 this limited profile requires taxable base equal to annual income."

"Bulgaria 2026: single full-year resident aged 18–59, ordinary salary only, no dependents, other income, special regime, tax credits or filing discounts. Currency is EUR from 2026; do not enter old BGN amounts without independent conversion. 10% of final verified annual base after lawful employee contributions/deductions. No automatic FX or statutory payroll rounding."

"Romania 2026: single full-year resident aged 18–59, one ordinary domestic salary job, no dependents, other income, special regime or tax credits. 10% of the verified sum of monthly taxable salary bases after lawful contributions, personal deductions and applicable minimum-wage exemptions. Monthly legal conditions must be checked individually; this annual reserve does not determine them."

"Hungary 2026: single full-year resident aged 25–59, ordinary fully taxable salary only; no children, other income, exemptions, base allowances or tax credits. Excludes under-25, mother/family, disability/newlywed relief and simplified/seasonal employment. 15% of annual salary; in this profile verified taxable base must equal annual employment income. Employee insurance does not reduce it."

"Georgia 2026: single full-year resident aged 18–59, ordinary fully taxable Georgian salary only, no dependents, other/foreign income, exemptions, special business regime or tax credits. 20% of annual salary. Verified taxable base must equal annual employment income. Actual employee pension/other cash is deducted from payout, not again from the tax base."

"Armenia 2026: single full-year resident aged 18–59, ordinary fully taxable domestic salary only; no dependents, other/foreign income, special sector rates, exemptions, mortgage/social-expense refunds or tax credits. 20% of annual salary; verified taxable base equals annual employment income. Actual employee pension, stamp duty and applicable health-insurance cash are supplied separately."

"Enter verified employment income for the whole 2026 calendar year, including bonuses, extra salary and correctly valued taxable benefits, plus the verified final annual taxable base. For Romania the base is the sum of verified monthly bases. Annual tax/12 is reserved against period cash; annual bonuses/noncash benefits are not added to the displayed payout."

"Verify all legal base deductions and exemptions before entering the final annual amount; the app does not decide eligibility. Georgia, Armenia and Hungary: base equals annual salary in these profiles; employee insurance does not reduce it. Lithuania: ordinary NPD only, no reduction above the stated profile threshold. Update both annual inputs when circumstances change."

"Enter actual employee social/health/pension and other non-PIT cash deductions for the period, or 0. Armenia includes actual stamp duty/health premiums when applicable. Exclude employer costs and income tax already reserved here. Lawful tax effects must already be in the verified base; do not deduct cash or reliefs twice. Annual estimate, not a payslip or tax return."

"Scope: single full-year tax resident aged 18–59, one ordinary domestic job, no dependents, other/foreign income, special regime or tax credits beyond those stated. Country and language do not establish eligibility. Confirm the full profile. Values apply to every viewed period; update verified figures when pay or circumstances change."

"Mexico 2026: annual ISR tariff, not monthly withholding. No employment-subsidy eligibility in ANY month, minimum-wage exemption, special payments or credits. Conservative gate: annual final base/12 must exceed MXN11,492.66. This gate alone does not prove eligibility. Verify the whole-year final base and all exclusions/deductions."

"Brazil 2026: estimate for ONE ordinary monthly fully taxable cash payment, using a verified monthly base after either lawful deductions or the simplified deduction, never both. Includes the new monthly tax reduction. Excludes noncash/exempt payments, 13th salary, vacation/separate tax events, annual settlement and other credits. Verified full-year total must not exceed BRL600,000; this is a conservative app limit."

"Costa Rica 2026: ordinary monthly fully taxable cash salary. Salary tax applies BEFORE employee social deductions, using the 2026 salary bands. No spouse/child credits, exempt bonuses, 13th salary, separate or partial-month payment calculations. Actual employee cash deductions are separate."

"Guatemala 2026: verified final annual base after all lawful deductions/exemptions, including Q48,000 ordinary deduction AND the Q3,024 extraordinary 2026 deduction. No automatic 2027 indexed exemption. Tax: 5% up to Q300,000 of final base; 7% above. Verify any exempt aguinaldo/Bono14 and documented deductions in the base."

"Dominican Republic 2026: annual salary scale with published fixed quotas. Enter verified base BEFORE the tariff’s zero-rate band of RD$416,220; do not subtract that threshold again. No 2027 scale or education/other tax credits. Actual employee social cash is separate."

"Kenya 2026: verified final annual base after lawful deductions, including applicable SHIF, housing levy and pension deductions. Resident personal relief up to KES28,800/year is included once, nonrefundable. No private-insurance relief or other credits/special exemptions. Actual employee cash deductions are separate; no second deduction from base."

"Rwanda 2026: ordinary first-employer employment only, verified annual base. Casual-labour 15% treatment, second employers, board fees and special regimes are excluded. Annual tariff/12 is a reserve, not actual variable-month PAYE. Enter actual employee cash contributions separately."

"Uganda FY2026/27: 1 July 2026–30 June 2027. NEW resident bands effective July 2026. Reserve assumes 12 equal taxable monthly amounts; not a variable-month/YTD calculation. No old 235,000 threshold or nonresident scale. Additional 10% above UGX10m taxable/month is included."

"Zambia 2026: ordinary annualised salary bands, including the ZMW5,100 monthly zero band. Enter verified annual base and actual employee cash deductions. No disability, special-employment or other tax credits. Employer costs are excluded."

"Pakistan FY2026/27, tax year2027: enacted Finance Act2026 salary bands. Salary-only resident with verified total annual employment income at most PKR10m. Surcharge, super-tax, pension, business and special-credit cases excluded. No 2025/26 table or proposed-bill rates."

"Uzbekistan 2026: ordinary fully taxable resident salary, 12%; verified annual base equals annual salary. No special exemptions/voluntary pension relief. Any funded-pension amount allocated WITHIN the 12% is already included in this reserve: do NOT enter it again as an extra cash deduction. Employer social tax is excluded."

"Kazakhstan 2026: new 10%/15% annual scale at 8,500 MCI; MCI=KZT4,325. Verified base already includes the ordinary full-year 360-MCI deduction and lawful social deductions, not the old 14-MCI rule. No private-practice, business, dividend or special social-relief profile."
